summary.title: YSO INVEST AS

narrative.text: YSO INVEST AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Andre egeninvesteringsselskaper", registered 2010-10-11.
Registered activity: Selskapets formål er å eie aksjer og/eller andeler i PricewaterhouseCoopers, i tillegg til at selskapet kan inneha andre finansielle eiendeler.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 1.2 million and an annual result of NOK 1.2 million.
Head office in Drammen, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
